title: Shifting a counter-program input position
statement: Given a counter-program state $s$ and a natural number $n$, the shifted state has the same label, register values, and output as $s$, while its input-read position is increased by $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The state has R registers indexed by Fin R.
The shift amount n is a natural number.
